# 2BIRDS

> 2BIRDS is a management consultancy specialising in the training and adult
> education sector. We advise leading training providers on operational
> governance, accreditation standards and instructional design.
>
> In practice that covers WSQ and CASL-aligned courseware development,
> Organisation Registration with the Skills and Workforce Development Agency
> (SWDA), preparation for the Training Provider Quality Assessment (TPQA),
> a customised training management system (Nest), professional workshops for
> training operations, and creative marketing within SWDA's Marketing Code of
> Practice.

Key facts:
- 2BIRDS PRIVATE LIMITED (UEN 202625717Z), 7 Temasek Boulevard, #12-07 Suntec
  Tower One, Singapore 038987. hello@2birds.asia. +65 8595 3945.
- Courseware and curriculum development for Singapore's funded-training sector,
  mapped to the Skills Framework and the Course Approval Skills List (CASL),
  submitted through TPGateway. Curriculum developers are accredited under DACE
  (Diploma in Adult and Continuing Education) or DDDLP (Diploma in Design and
  Development of Learning for Performance).
- The regulator is the Skills and Workforce Development Agency (SWDA). Scheme
  names such as SkillsFuture Credit are unchanged.
- 2BIRDS is a private consultancy. It is not part of, appointed by or acting
  for SWDA or any public authority. Regulatory outcomes rest with SWDA.
- TPQA advisory is reserved for training providers with an active engagement
  with 2BIRDS.
- No fees are published on the website. Every engagement is priced in a written
  proposal after a scoping discussion.
